question: Should the official WhatsApp plugin expose an opt-in `post-status` message action for automated Status publication with explicit per-call audiences?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing broadcast capability and configuration surface rather than repairing an established contract, and the linked issue has not received maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow capability
options.body: Accept the plugin-owned, disabled-by-default design after redacted live audience and media proof is added.

options.title: Narrow the initial scope
options.body: Allow only text and image Status updates initially, deferring video and voice until each path has live proof.

options.title: Decline automated Status publishing
options.body: Keep Status publication outside the official plugin because of privacy, abuse, or product-scope concerns.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow capability
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin-owned, disabled-by-default design after redacted live audience and media proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct ownership of the WhatsApp channel runtime and action-loading boundaries affected by this decision.
